title: Bitcoin vs. Gold: The Exact Chart Confirming a Massive Breakout
speaker: Nick Valdez (Verified Investing)

macro_themes.view: Q4 is when Bitcoin sees a lot of activity; BTC vs gold set up for outperformance.
10-year at levels not seen since 2002 is shaking markets; JOLTS/consumer confidence pop in yields liquidated BTC longs.
Falling BTC dominance and a break of its trend line would signal altcoin outperformance.

calls.condition: May flush toward ~82k liquidation cluster before heading up; BTC/gold may consolidate ~a month before resuming
calls.reason: Bounce off Nov-wick/May-high range with oversold 15m RSI; BTC priced in gold bottomed after the same ~62-week decline as prior cycles, historically followed by multi-year outperformance vs gold.
calls.quote: So Bitcoin, you know, as far as gold is concerned, starting to look a little bit bullish.

calls.condition: If it keeps falling, expects relief at the established trend line
calls.reason: Trend line from prior wicks has repeatedly held as support.
calls.quote: this is the level that I'm expecting some relief for ex uh ETH

calls.condition: If it consolidates overnight and pushes up again, short around 180
calls.reason: Big pump piggybacking the ISO 20022 altcoin pump; fading the extension.
calls.quote: I like a short right around 180.

calls.reason: Bearish RSI divergence on the daily (higher price highs, lower RSI highs); among biggest losers.
calls.quote: We talked about Zcash looking terrible on the daily RSI. These are called bear diversions

calls.reason: Limit long orders lower near the Sep 24 wick and nearby wicks as a potential long area; closed most of overnight long for profit.
calls.quote: So, it's going to be a maybe a nice potential long area for XRP.

calls.condition: Short if price interacts with the hourly trend line again
calls.reason: Major pump into a tradeable hourly trend line.
calls.quote: But I do like a short if we interact with this level again.

calls.reason: Looks like a bear flag while tapping liquidation levels; avoid new positions.
calls.quote: right now, that's looking like a bear flag. So, you might not want to get into a position on that one
